name: Fishing
description: How fishing works here: Tide runs every fishing rod.

pages.title: Fishing
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Tide** runs fishing: hold to cast, then win a short timing game when a fish bites.
- Where, when and how deep you fish decides what bites.
- Upgrade rods at an **Angling Table**; bait makes fish bite sooner.
- The **Fishing Journal** records every fish you catch.

Fishing in Create Galore is run by **Tide**. Every plain Fishing Rod is a Tide rod, including ones made before Tide joined the pack.\
\
More than 180 fish bite across rivers, oceans, caves, lava and the void, from Tide itself, Hybrid Aquatic, Aquaculture, Alex's Caves and a few others.

pages.title: Fishing Journal
pages.text: Every player gets one on joining. Catch a fish to unlock its page: where it lives, when it bites, and your biggest one so far.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** day one, a plain rod (3 sticks, 2 string) is enough. Any open river or sea gives fish to cook on a campfire. See [#](2E5AAC)[Food in Your First Days](entry://food/first_food)[#]().\
\
Aquaculture's own rods and tackle are retired here; see [#](2E5AAC)[Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods](entry://fishing/aquaculture)[#]().
